text:
Priya (PM): quick async standup — handing off roadmap items for the week. TL;DR: need spec signoff on A/B routing, confirm canary targets, and surface any blockers. What I did / Blockers / Today.

Liam (Eng): reviewed routing spec, left inline comments on the canary config. Blocker: unclear latency SLO for background batching. Today: will push a PR for fallback routing.

Anya (Design): uploaded updated UX mock for rollout modal (link in Figma). No blockers. Today: add microcopy for degraded-mode banner.

Jamal (SRE): staging canary metrics mostly green but saw 2 small OOMs last night — investigating heap pressure in dedicated pool. Assigning to @Liam. Also need approval to increase memory for dedicated pool.

Nora (Prod Ops): FYI: Friday maintenance window conflicts — prefer canary earlier Thu 3pm PT. Also we need route-level billing tags added (config key: `route_tag: "billing-team"`).

Liam (Eng): ack @Jamal, will add memory bump + safety valve to the PR. Quick Q: confirm target QPS for canary? @Priya

Priya (PM): target QPS = 20% of prod baseline (~1.2k qps) for initial canary, 30% if stable for 24h. If OOMs persist, fallback to lighter quantized variant and roll back routing changes.

Jamal (SRE): noted. If we fallback, we need a short test plan and postmortem template. I'll draft a canary runbook and share.

Anya (Design): UX question — when fallback happens, show subtle banner or hide behavior? I prefer subtle banner with brief explanation + link to support.

Priya (PM): subtle banner + link to support is fine. @Nora can you verify compliance/legal wording?

Nora (Prod Ops): will loop in Legal if the banner mentions customer data handling. Otherwise OK.

Liam (Eng): PR opened: https://git.internal/r/1245 — includes memory bump and fallback toggle. Tagging reviewers: @Priya @Anya @Jamal.

Priya (PM): added to review queue. Can reviewers please aim to respond by EOD today so we can unblock staging canary Thu AM?

Anya (Design): I can review by 4pm PT.

Jamal (SRE): I'll validate canary metrics after deploy, target 11am PT Thu for checks.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: staging -> canary at 2026-03-19T15:00:00Z. Notifying channel eng-oncall.

Priya (PM): checklist for visibility (quick copy):
```
- [ ] Spec signoff (Anya)
- [ ] Memory bump PR merged (Liam)
- [ ] Canary runbook + test plan (Jamal)
- [ ] Deployment window confirmed (Nora)
```

Priya (PM): blockers summary: OOMs (Jamal) + spec signoff pending (Anya). If anything else pops up, drop a quick note here. :thumbsup:

Liam (Eng): will follow up in PR comments with measurements and a small benchmark.

Nora (Prod Ops): confirming Thu 15:00 PT works for Ops, will update calendar invite and add legal if needed.

Jamal (SRE): thanks — posting runbook draft in docs/ canary-runbooks later today.

Priya (PM): great progress, appreciate the quick turn.
